issues.on_page: Customer accounting and collections 5,438,729 (functional expense line beside Production, Distribution, Administrative and general)
issues.issue: This is a utility function line (like Distribution), which the cost-type rule says stays 'utilities'; nothing on the page says contract/professional services. FY2024 uses the same category, so flagged rather than called an error.

issues.on_page: Contributed capital 461,522; Cost recovered through CC (192,928); Gain (loss) on sale of assets (120,574) printed under Nonoperating revenues (expenses)
issues.issue: The (120,574) loss is printed inside nonoperating revenues (expenses); under the 2026-11-06 ruling (Scottsbluff loss stays in nonoperating as Loss on Disposal of Assets) it could be a business-type disbursement line instead of other_financing. Roll-forward ties either way; FY2024 treats it the same way.
Grantor not printed; the rules say do not guess a grantor (could be federal or state).

Printed 'Business' tax in the 911 fund is probably a 911 surcharge/telephone occupation tax; the Statement of Activities prints the Business total as 'Other taxes' (p2). Printed tax label kept, so defensible.

Printed function is Environment and leisure; category Airport comes from the fund name (marked computed). Same for detail[84] Transit Lines Fund 77,203 -> Mass Transit (a category used so far only for Lincoln/Clay Center).

Airport intergovernmental money is often FAA (federal) grants; source not printed. Similarly CDBG Fund Intergovernmental 986,332 (detail[60]) recorded as federal grants from the fund name, and Street Fund Intergovernmental 4,260,072 (detail[20]) as highway allocation: assumptions, not printed.

issues.extracted: 14 nonmajor fund columns recorded per fund
issues.on_page: Combining statement pp12-13, 14 fund columns plus Total Non-Major
issues.issue: Extractor rule says per fund for up to 6 funds, Total column ('Nonmajor funds (combined)') above that; per-fund recording conflicts with that rule though it matches the later per-fund preference. All 14 columns tie to their printed totals and to the Total column.
